caption: The drawing depicts a single brown bonnet, which appears to be made of a smooth fabric. The bonnet has a rounded, semi-cylindrical crown that forms the main structure and is bordered by a lighter brown trim along the edge. At the back of the bonnet, fabric is gathered and extends outward, suggesting a loose or ruched construction. Two long, flat ribbons of the same brown color hang down from below the bonnet, likely intended to tie under the chin. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown and tan, with some areas shaded to suggest dimension and the folds in the fabric. The background is a plain, light off-white color with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Shaker Bonnet
